findings.quote: (b) IN NO EVENT SHALL LICENSOR'S AGGREGATE CUMULATIVE TOTAL LIABILITY UNDER THIS AGREEMENT EXCEED ONE HALF OF THE AMOUNT PAID BY THE LICENSEE TO Licensor HEREUNDER.
findings.rationale: The cap is one-sided (only Licensor is capped) and set at one half of amounts paid, far below our 6-month floor, while our liability is unlimited and expanded by the risk-assumption language in p0029/p0037/p0039. We need a mutual cap at 12 months' fees with standard uncapped carve-outs.

replacement.oldText: (b) IN NO EVENT SHALL LICENSOR'S AGGREGATE CUMULATIVE TOTAL LIABILITY UNDER THIS AGREEMENT EXCEED ONE HALF OF THE AMOUNT PAID BY THE LICENSEE TO Licensor HEREUNDER.
replacement.newText: (b) EXCEPT FOR EXCLUDED CLAIMS, EACH PARTY'S TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT EXCEED THE FEES PAID OR PAYABLE BY LICENSEE UNDER THIS AGREEMENT IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING THE EVENT GIVING RISE TO THE CLAIM. "EXCLUDED CLAIMS" MEANS A PARTY'S BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY, DATA PROTECTION OR SECURITY OBLIGATIONS, ITS INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS, ITS GROSS NEGLIGENCE, WILFUL MISCONDUCT OR FRAUD, AND ITS INFRINGEMENT OF THE OTHER PARTY'S INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS; EXCLUDED CLAIMS AND LICENSEE'S PAYMENT OBLIGATIONS ARE NOT SUBJECT TO THE FOREGOING CAP. THE EXCLUSION OF INDIRECT AND CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES IN SUBSECTION (a) SHALL APPLY EQUALLY TO BOTH PARTIES.
replacement.comment: [Playbook] We have made the cap mutual and moved it to 12 months' fees, with confidentiality, indemnity, gross negligence/wilful misconduct and IP infringement sitting outside the cap. A one-half-of-fees cap for the Licensor with unlimited exposure for us is not something we can accept.

findings.quote: Licensee shall defend, indemnify, and hold Licensor harmless from and against any and all suits, claims, proceedings, judgments, awards, damages, loss, liability, cost and expenses
findings.rationale: Article XII is a one-way, very broad indemnity from us, and p0130 expressly disclaims any Licensor liability for IP infringement claims arising from our use of the Platform. We need a Licensor IP-infringement indemnity plus indemnities for its breach of law, data incidents and wilful misconduct, and our indemnity narrowed to our content and our breach of law.

replacement.oldText: (ii) the conduct of Licensee's business directly or through any affiliate of Licensee and/or (iii) the breach by the License of any representation, warranty, obligation, restriction, term and/or covenant under this Agreement.
replacement.newText: (ii) the conduct of Licensee's business directly or through any affiliate of Licensee and/or (iii) the breach by the Licensee of any representation, warranty, obligation, restriction, term and/or covenant under this Agreement, in each case excluding any claim for which Licensor is responsible under the following sentence. Licensor shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless Licensee and its affiliates from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (a) an allegation that the Licensed Technology infringes or misappropriates any intellectual property right; (b) Licensor's breach of applicable law; (c) any unauthorised access to or disclosure of Licensee's data caused by Licensor; or (d) Licensor's gross negligence or wilful misconduct.
replacement.comment: [Playbook] We have added the Licensor's indemnity, in particular for third-party IP infringement claims relating to the Platform, since we cannot take that risk on a licensed product we do not control. Our indemnity is correspondingly limited to claims not covered by the Licensor's.

findings.quote: THE LICENSED TECHNOLOGY IS PROVIDED ON AN "AS IS" BASIS WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY KIND AND LICENSOR HEREBY
findings.rationale: The Agreement is pure "AS IS" with no express performance or conformance warranty and no remedy, which is our walk-away position for a platform we pay usage fees and support fees for.

replacement.oldText: THE LICENSED TECHNOLOGY IS PROVIDED ON AN "AS IS" BASIS WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY KIND AND LICENSOR HEREBY
replacement.newText: Licensor warrants that (a) the Technical Support Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards; (b) the Licensed Technology will conform in all material respects to its Documentation; and (c) the Licensed Technology contains no malicious code. Licensee's remedy for breach of this warranty is, at Licensor's option, correction of the non-conformity or a refund of the fees paid for the affected period. EXCEPT FOR THE FOREGOING EXPRESS WARRANTIES, THE LICENSED TECHNOLOGY IS PROVIDED ON AN "AS IS" BASIS WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY KIND AND LICENSOR HEREBY
replacement.comment: [Playbook] We have added a short conformance/workmanlike warranty with a repair-or-refund remedy and carved it out of the disclaimer; a fully "AS IS" trading platform is not acceptable.

findings.quote: Subject to termination pursuant to this Agreement, the Non Exclusive license granted by Licensor to Licensee shall be for an initial period of 36 months, commencing from the acceptance date, (the "Initial Period").
findings.rationale: A 36-month term with no Licensee right to terminate for convenience, coupled with immediate Licensor termination for any breach (no cure period), is our walk-away position. We need a 30-day convenience right and a cure period before Licensor termination.

replacement.oldText: Upon any breach by Licensee of any representation, warranty, covenant and/or obligation hereunder, the Licensor may immediately terminate this Agreement and prohibit the Licensee's use of any and/or all of the Licensed Technology.
replacement.newText: Upon any material breach by Licensee of any representation, warranty, covenant and/or obligation hereunder which remains uncured thirty (30) days after written notice, the Licensor may terminate this Agreement and prohibit the Licensee's use of any and/or all of the Licensed Technology. Licensee may terminate this Agreement for convenience, in whole or in part, upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to Licensor, in which case Licensor shall refund any prepaid fees for the period after the effective date of termination.
replacement.comment: [Playbook] We have added a 30-day convenience right for us and a 30-day cure period before the Licensor can terminate. Immediate termination for any breach of a 36-month licence leaves our trading operations exposed.

findings.quote: The Agreement may be renewed for an additional period of seven (7) years at the option of the Licensor.
findings.rationale: A seven-year renewal exercisable unilaterally by the Licensor is an automatic multi-year extension we cannot exit — our walk-away position. Renewal should be by mutual agreement in 12-month increments (consistent with the mutual-extension language later in the same Article).

replacement.oldText: The Agreement may be renewed for an additional period of seven (7) years at the option of the Licensor.
replacement.newText: The Agreement may be renewed for additional periods of twelve (12) months upon the mutual written agreement of the parties.
replacement.comment: [Playbook] Renewal must be mutual and in 12-month increments; a unilateral seven-year extension at the Licensor's option is not acceptable and conflicts with the mutual-extension language in the same Article.

findings.quote: Upon the occurrence of any Change of Control (as defined below) this Agreement and all Licensee's rights and licenses hereunder shall automatically terminate unless, prior to the occurrence of such Change of Control, Licensor has consented to such Change of Control in a writing executed by an officer of Licensor
findings.rationale: Automatic termination of our licence on our own change of control, with consent deemed reasonably withheld on broad grounds (and a related right of first refusal in Article XXII), is our walk-away position; it hands the Licensor a veto over our M&A.

replacement.oldText: Until such an agreement is entered into in writing, the Licensor shall have no obligation to perform such work.
replacement.newText: Until such an agreement is entered into in writing, the Licensor shall have no obligation to perform such work. Licensee shall own all right, title and interest in any deliverable, custom front end or other work product created specifically for Licensee and paid for by Licensee, and Licensor hereby assigns such rights to Licensee; Licensor retains ownership of its pre-existing intellectual property and grants Licensee a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense any such pre-existing intellectual property to the extent embedded in those deliverables. Licensee retains all right, title and interest in Licensee's data, including its trade, order and client data processed through the Platform.
replacement.comment: [Playbook] We own what we pay for and everything we put in: bespoke deliverables should vest in us (with a licence back of the Licensor's underlying platform IP), and our trading and client data must remain ours.

findings.quote: During the Term of this Agreement and during the three year period after the expiration or termination of this Agreement, the Licensee will not solicit any person employed by Licensor and/or its Affiliates to leave his or her employment with Licensor.
findings.rationale: A one-way, three-year post-term non-solicit covering all Licensor and affiliate employees exceeds our walk-away threshold (24 months / all personnel). It should be mutual, 12 months, and limited to personnel involved in the services; the advertising carve-out already present can stay.

replacement.oldText: During the Term of this Agreement and during the three year period after the expiration or termination of this Agreement, the Licensee will not solicit any person employed by Licensor and/or its Affiliates to leave his or her employment with Licensor.
replacement.newText: During the Term of this Agreement and during the twelve (12) month period after the expiration or termination of this Agreement, neither party will solicit any person employed by the other party who was directly involved in the performance or receipt of the services under this Agreement to leave his or her employment.
replacement.comment: [Playbook] We have made the non-solicit mutual, cut it to 12 months and limited it to personnel actually involved in the engagement. The general-advertising carve-out in the following sentence is retained.

findings.quote: Any such audit shall be permitted by Licensee within 30 days of Licensee's receipt of a written request of Licensor.
findings.rationale: The audit right has no frequency limit, no advance-notice period and no restriction on access to our systems. Cost allocation (Licensor pays unless a 5% discrepancy) is acceptable.

replacement.oldText: Any such audit shall be permitted by Licensee within 30 days of Licensee's receipt of a written request of Licensor.
replacement.newText: Any such audit shall be conducted no more than once in any twelve (12) month period, upon at least thirty (30) days' prior written notice, during normal business hours, by an auditor bound by written confidentiality obligations, and shall not include access to Licensee's systems.
replacement.comment: [Playbook] Audits of our records should be no more than annual, on 30 days' notice, by a confidentiality-bound auditor and without access to our systems. The existing 5% cost-shifting threshold is acceptable.

findings.quote: Licensee shall, within five (5) days, ship to Licensor all Licensed Technology, API's Documentation with respect to the Licensed Technology and other Confidential Information in Licensee's possession or control
findings.rationale: Termination imposes a 5-day return obligation on us but gives us no right to our own trade and client data or any transition assistance — our walk-away position for a hosted platform.

replacement.oldText: All of the Licensor's rights under this Agreement shall survive termination of this Agreement.
replacement.newText: All of the Licensor's rights under this Agreement shall survive termination of this Agreement. Upon expiry or termination for any reason, Licensor shall (a) at Licensee's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Licensor's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days, return all Licensee data, including trade, order and client records, in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete such data from its systems and certify such deletion in writing.
replacement.comment: [Playbook] We need our data back in a usable format and reasonable transition help on exit; we are also happy to extend the 5-day return period for the Licensor's materials to align with this.

findings.quote: (b) COMPLIANCE WITH LAWS. Licensee agrees to comply in all material respects with all applicable laws, rules, and regulations in connection with its activities under this Agreement
findings.rationale: No insurance obligation on the Licensor, which hosts the platform and processes our trade and client data. We should insert a short insurance paragraph in the general provisions.

replacement.oldText: (b) COMPLIANCE WITH LAWS. Licensee agrees to comply in all material respects with all applicable laws, rules, and regulations in connection with its activities under this Agreement
replacement.newText: (b) COMPLIANCE WITH LAWS; INSURANCE. Licensor shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term and for one (1) year thereafter: commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; and cyber liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000, and shall provide certificates of insurance on request. Licensee agrees to comply in all material respects with all applicable laws, rules, and regulations in connection with its activities under this Agreement
replacement.comment: [Playbook] Standard insurance for a vendor hosting our platform and processing our trade data; E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M is our fallback if these limits are an issue.

findings.quote: shall be governed by the internal laws of the State of New York, U.S.A.
findings.rationale: New York law with exclusive jurisdiction in New York City courts matches our preferred position; no arbitration.

findings.quote: Licensee acknowledges that the grant of the license set forth in this Section is a non-exclusive license
findings.rationale: No exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation is imposed on us; the licence is expressly non-exclusive in both directions.

findings.quote: As compensation for the Licensee to use the Licensed Technology during the Initial Period, Licensee shall pay to Licensor, the following user fees:
findings.rationale: No most-favoured-nation obligation burdening us appears in the pricing or elsewhere.

findings.quote: The Licensee shall calculate the license fee payable to the Licensor for each month based on the Monthly Notional Volume bands for that pay period
findings.rationale: Fees are purely usage-based (per US$1m traded) with no minimum volume commitment, take-or-pay or shortfall payment.

findings.quote: In no event shall the amount payable by the Licensor be less than the amount recorded by the Licensee as being traded with the Licensed Technology multiplied by the applicable Fees set forth above.
findings.rationale: This sentence names the wrong party ("payable by the Licensor") and operates as a payment floor; it is not a liquidated damage as drafted, but we should confirm it is a drafting error and not a minimum-fee mechanic. Note also the Licensor's stated right on immediate termination to "receive payments for all trades performed".

findings.quote: "FIELD OF USE" means, and is limited to, the utilization of the Licensed Technology by the Licensee for the exclusive purpose of fulfilling Spot FX transactions by transmitting market data and orders.
findings.rationale: The restrictions are field-of-use limits on the licensed software rather than restraints on our business generally, so no redline is proposed; however the derivative-works ban (p0044) and the third-party distribution consent requirement (p0027) should be checked against our own product roadmap for internal development.
